_note: Illustrative approximation of real program structure for a hackathon demo. Figures are synthetic and must not be relied on operationally.

pucRule.title: California residential disconnection and arrearage rules
pucRule.summary: Caps reconnection fees, requires extended amortization of arrears, and limits residential disconnection for non-payment.

deferredPaymentArrangement.note: Residential customers are entitled to amortize arrears over at least 12 months with no down payment required.

moratoria.label: Extreme weather disconnection suspension
moratoria.appliesTo: Residential customers in an area under an excessive heat warning

moratoria.label: Freezing conditions suspension
moratoria.appliesTo: Residential customers when forecast lows reach freezing

authorityRule.title: Meridian Energy voice-agent delegated authority — California
authorityRule.text: Voice agents may agree residual payment arrangements at or above $140 per month in California. Amounts below the floor require credit-officer approval at authority level L2 or above.
